auctions_prices_check.name: auctions_prices_check
auctions_prices_check.value: ("auctions"."start_price" is null or "auctions"."start_price" >= 0) and ("auctions"."reserve_price" is null or "auctions"."reserve_price" >= 0) and ("auctions"."buy_now_price" is null or "auctions"."buy_now_price" >= 0)

auctions_published_check.name: auctions_published_check
auctions_published_check.value: "auctions"."status" in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'CANCELLED') or ("auctions"."starts_at" is not null and "auctions"."ends_at" is not null and "auctions"."start_price" is not null)

ledger_accounts_seller_check.name: ledger_accounts_seller_check
ledger_accounts_seller_check.value: (code in ('seller_receivable', 'buyer_funds_held', 'seller_balance_available', 'payouts_in_transit')) = (seller_id is not null) and (code not in ('seller_receivable', 'seller_balance_available') or subject = seller_id::text)

ledger_accounts_seller_amount_check.name: ledger_accounts_seller_amount_check
ledger_accounts_seller_amount_check.value: ("ledger_accounts"."code" = 'buyer_funds_held') = ("ledger_accounts"."seller_amount" is not null) and ("ledger_accounts"."seller_amount" is null or "ledger_accounts"."seller_amount" >= 0)

ledger_accounts_balance_side_check.name: ledger_accounts_balance_side_check
ledger_accounts_balance_side_check.value: (code not in ('buyer_funds_held', 'seller_balance_available', 'payouts_in_transit') or balance <= 0) and (code not in ('seller_receivable', 'carrier_claims_receivable') or balance >= 0)

fake_gateway_payments_status_check.name: fake_gateway_payments_status_check
fake_gateway_payments_status_check.value: status in ('PENDING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') and (failure_reason is null or failure_reason in ('DECLINED', 'INVALID_BLIK_CODE', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'SELLER_NOT_VERIFIED', 'PROVIDER_ERROR'))

payments_failure_reason_check.name: payments_failure_reason_check
payments_failure_reason_check.value: (status = 'FAILED') = (failure_reason is not null) and (failure_reason is null or failure_reason in ('DECLINED', 'INVALID_BLIK_CODE', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'SELLER_NOT_VERIFIED', 'PROVIDER_ERROR'))

carrier_claims_amounts_check.name: carrier_claims_amounts_check
carrier_claims_amounts_check.value: "carrier_claims"."claimed_amount" > 0 and ("carrier_claims"."recovered_amount" is null or "carrier_claims"."recovered_amount" between 0 and "carrier_claims"."claimed_amount")

carrier_claims_resolution_check.name: carrier_claims_resolution_check
carrier_claims_resolution_check.value: ("carrier_claims"."status" in ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED')) = ("carrier_claims"."resolved_at" is not null and "carrier_claims"."recovered_amount" is not null)

shipments_dispatch_method_check.name: shipments_dispatch_method_check
shipments_dispatch_method_check.value: dispatch_method is null or dispatch_method in ('DROP_OFF', 'COURIER_PICKUP')
